plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-030 Participants hidden on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the configuration under test so vendor addition is locked during event creation.
Apply the requested tenant configuration before creating the draft.
Provide the mandatory title for the draft.
Configure the draft as an eRFX project with an RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the draft can be saved.
Add the minimum line item needed for a valid saved draft.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving.
Save the eRFX project as an unpublished draft.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to access the saved draft through the requested flow.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in Drafts.
Open the plan's saved draft from the Drafts list.
Assert that Participants is not offered on the reopened eRFX draft when vendor addition is locked off.
